description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Older name for co_invent_read, kept so a connector with a saved tool list keeps working. Read any part of a pass, as a person reads it in the app. part: list (what's there), brief, shortlist, concept, brainstorm, review, mustdos, requirements, spec, bom, risks, business, market, engineering, diagrams, patent, claimcheck, rounds, app, checks, provenance, activity, debbie, attribution, commons (a2a2p's claims repository search: prior art found while reading, unpublished Invention Commons listings kept as precedence risks with their listing dates, and the package's notices of Commons inventions whose claims may overlap the drafted claims, by public teaser only) or reading (the reading step's ranked list of everything in the idea and its attachments, function and mechanism first, each item with its source, and how many of each attachment's items reached the brainstorm, design, concepts, shortlist, requirements and package); export gives the whole package as one JSON; pack gives the private links to the finished package for its owner.
name: co_invent_pass_read
